gloss: to dish up; to plate (food); to arrange on a plate

forms.label: Past polite
forms.negative: {盛|も}り{付|つ}けませんでした

forms.label: ている past
forms.negative: {盛|も}り{付|つ}けていなかった

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {盛|も}り{付|つ}けていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to dish up; to plate food; to arrange food on a dish
definitions.explanation: To arrange and present food attractively on a plate or dish. Emphasizes both the act of serving and the aesthetic presentation.

examples.japanese: サラダを{皿|さら}に{盛|も}り{付|つ}ける。
examples.english: To plate the salad on a dish.

examples.japanese: {料理|りょうり}をきれいに{盛|も}り{付|つ}けるのは{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: It's important to plate food beautifully.

examples.japanese: シェフは{一|ひと}つひとつの{料理|りょうり}を{丁寧|ていねい}に{盛|も}り{付|つ}けて、{彩|いろど}りにも{気|き}を{配|くば}っていた。
examples.english: The chef carefully plated each dish, paying attention to the color arrangement as well.

notes:
{盛|も}り{付|つ}ける is a transitive ichidan verb. The noun form is {盛|も}り{付|つ}け (plating, presentation).

ASPECT (ている):
{盛|も}り{付|つ}けている indicates the action is in progress.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- AをBに{盛|も}り{付|つ}ける (to plate A on B)
- {料理|りょうり}を{盛|も}り{付|つ}ける (to plate food)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- きれいに{盛|も}り{付|つ}ける (to plate beautifully)
- {丁寧|ていねい}に{盛|も}り{付|つ}ける (to plate carefully)
- {大皿|おおざら}に{盛|も}り{付|つ}ける (to plate on a large dish)
- {盛|も}り{付|つ}けの{仕方|しかた} (way of plating)

In Japanese cuisine, presentation is highly valued. The related noun {盛|も}り{付|つ}け is used broadly for the art of food presentation.
